title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
events_chronological: As a young woman in China, Evelyn defies her father Gong Gong to emigrate to America with Waymond.
Evelyn and Waymond open a laundromat, and every other life she might have had closes off one by one.
Their daughter Joy grows up feeling judged, and Evelyn cannot bring herself to accept her girlfriend Becky.
In the Alphaverse, a version of Evelyn invents verse-jumping and pushes her own daughter's mind across every universe at once until it shatters, making Jobu Tupaki.
Jobu Tupaki builds the everything bagel, a black hole of everything that ever mattered, and starts hunting for the Evelyn who can face her.
In the laundromat, Evelyn prepares for a tax audit while Waymond tries and fails to hand her divorce papers.
Gong Gong arrives from China for the Chinese New Year party, and Evelyn hides Becky from him.
In the lift to the IRS office, Alpha-Waymond takes over her husband's body and gives Evelyn an earpiece and a set of instructions.
Evelyn verse-jumps for the first time in a supply closet and fights the security guards with skills borrowed from a movie-star version of herself.
The auditor Deirdre Beaubeirdre turns berserk, and the IRS building becomes a battlefield.
Evelyn is shown the Alphaverse and told that Jobu Tupaki is her own daughter.
Evelyn jumps through lives she never lived - film star, opera singer, teppanyaki chef, a world where people have hot dogs for fingers, two rocks on a cliff.
Alpha-Waymond is killed, and Evelyn's mind begins to come apart as she jumps too far.
Evelyn confronts Jobu Tupaki, who says she does not want to kill her but wants her to see that nothing matters.
Believing nothing matters, Evelyn turns on the people around her and nearly follows Joy into the bagel.
Waymond, in every universe at once, asks her to be kind, and Evelyn starts fighting with kindness instead.
Evelyn gives each attacker what they actually need, wins Gong Gong's acceptance of Becky, and reaches Joy at the edge of the bagel.
Evelyn tells Joy that even if nothing matters she would still choose to be here with her, and pulls her back.
Back at the IRS office the family files the return together, and Evelyn's attention drifts for a moment across every universe at once.
syuzhet_notes: The film's present is one afternoon at an IRS office, and everything else arrives as intrusion rather than flashback in the ordinary sense: told-order bullets 7-8 explain an origin in another universe, bullets 10-11 and 14 reach back into Evelyn's own past, and bullet 9 covers lives she never lived at all. From told-order bullet 9 the cutting accelerates until several universes occupy the same second.
fabula_notes: Most of the alternate universes are not events on one timeline but branches that never happened to this Evelyn, so a strict chronology can place only the ones that bear on her, in the order the film establishes them as causes. The Alphaverse history and the making of Jobu Tupaki are recounted by Alpha-Waymond rather than dramatised in sequence.
